title: Binary Tree Preorder Traversal
summary: Return the node values in this recursive visitation order: current node, left subtree, right subtree.

contractDetails.constraints: 0–100 nodes, each with a value in [−100,100]. Input uses level-order values with null for absent children, omitting trailing nulls. Return an integer array in the required order.
contractDetails.output-checking: Build a TreeNode tree from canonical level-order input. Return and compare the preorder integer sequence.

statement: Return the node values in this recursive visitation order: current node, left subtree, right subtree. Apply the same rule inside each subtree. An absent child contributes no values.

examples.explanation: The missing left child of 2 contributes no values.
An empty tree has no visits.

constraints: 0–100 nodes, each with a value in [−100,100]. Input uses level-order values with null for absent children, omitting trailing nulls. Return an integer array in the required order.
hints: Conceptual: A parent must appear before either subtree.
Directional: Record each node when first visiting it.
Implementation: Use a stack, pushing the right child before the left child so the left child is processed next.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(h) traversal stack space, excluding O(n) output, where h is tree height.
